moments.title: Strictly's Glittering Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its highly anticipated launch show this Saturday, revealing the celebrity-pro pairings.

angles.name: Launch Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for sequins, spray tans and sensational moves! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is this Saturday, revealing who's dancing with who. Who are you rooting for?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: New era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe take the helm this Saturday for the launch show. What do you think of the new presenting trio?

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series this Tuesday, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Baking is Back
angles.copy: The tent is open! Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday with a fresh batch of bakers and a new judge. Who's ready for some soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes?

angles.name: Nigella Joins
angles.copy: Exciting news in the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a judge for the new series starting this Tuesday. How do you think she'll fare?

moments.title: Tom Hardy Turns 49
moments.blurb: Acclaimed British actor Tom Hardy, known for roles in 'Peaky Blinders' and 'Mad Max', celebrates his 49th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Tom
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to the incredible Tom Hardy! From Bane to Alfie Solomons, what's your favourite Tom Hardy role?

moments.title: Nick Jonas Turns 34
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Nick Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and his solo career, celebrates his 34th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Jonas Brother's Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Nick Jonas turns 34! From pop heartthrob to solo star, what's your favourite Nick Jonas or Jonas Brothers track?

moments.title: Anastacia Turns 58
moments.blurb: The 'I'm Outta Love' singer Anastacia, known for her powerful vocals, celebrates her 58th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Sprock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the incredible Anastacia on Thursday! What's your favourite hit from the 'Little Lady with the Big Voice'?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
moments.blurb: The iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday next Monday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Alright, mad fer it! Liam Gallagher turns 54 next Monday. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the main man?

moments.title: Andrea Bocelli Turns 68
moments.blurb: World-renowned Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, celebrated for his crossover classical and pop music, celebrates his 68th birthday next Tuesday.

angles.name: Tenor's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, we're wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to the magnificent Andrea Bocelli. Which of his stunning performances moves you most?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen Turns 77
moments.blurb: The legendary 'Boss' of rock and roll, Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday next Wednesday.

angles.name: The Boss's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Bruce Springsteen next Wednesday! Which iconic 'Boss' track is your all-time favourite?

moments.title: Will Smith Turns 58
moments.blurb: Actor, rapper, and global superstar Will Smith, known for 'The Fresh Prince' and blockbuster movies, celebrates his 58th birthday next Friday.

angles.name: Fresh Prince Birthday
angles.copy: Yo, holmes, to Bel-Air! Will Smith turns 58 next Friday. What's your favourite Fresh Prince tune or movie moment?

moments.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Turns 57
moments.blurb: Award-winning Welsh actress Catherine Zeta-Jones celebrates her 57th birthday next Friday.

angles.name: Welsh Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Next Friday, a very Happy 57th Birthday to our very own Welsh icon, Catherine Zeta-Jones! What's your favourite film or TV role from her?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox officially marks the beginning of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, arriving next Tuesday.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Crisp air and changing leaves! The Autumn Equinox is next Tuesday, officially welcoming astronomical autumn. What's your favourite thing about this season?

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: The latest official UK Singles Chart will be updated and announced this Friday, revealing the nation's biggest hits.

angles.name: Chart Friday
angles.copy: Who's heading for Number 1? The new Official UK Singles Chart drops this Friday! Any predictions for the top spot?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues with a full schedule of fixtures across the UK this coming weekend (September 19-20).

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: Another massive Premier League weekend is almost here! What match are you most looking forward to and who do you think will grab the points?

moments.title: Midweek European Football
moments.blurb: European club football returns next week with Champions League group stage matches taking place across Tuesday and Wednesday (September 22-23).

angles.name: European Nights
angles.copy: Under the floodlights! Midweek sees the return of Champions League action. Who are you backing to shine in Europe next week?
